answer.question: Compare the top 3 open-source vector databases for a startup building RAG products.
answer.short_answer: Milvus, Weaviate, and Qdrant are all actively maintained open-source vector databases with Apache-2.0 licenses for Milvus and Qdrant, while Weaviate's license needs verification. Milvus stands out for billion‑scale capacity and multiple indexing options, Qdrant shows the highest raw query throughput and ultra‑low latency, and Weaviate offers built‑in hybrid search and RAG orchestration tools.
key_findings: All three projects have recent activity, with the latest code push on 2026-10-28 and no archival status. [c3, c6, c9]
Milvus and Qdrant are released under the Apache-2.0 license, whereas Weaviate's license is not auto‑detected and requires checking the repository. [c2, c5, c8]
Milvus has the largest community presence with 46,513 stars and 4,318 forks, followed by Qdrant (35,299 stars, 2,782 forks) and Weaviate (16,925 stars, 1,430 forks). [c1, c4, c7]
Milvus supports billions of vectors, multiple indexing algorithms, and a decoupled storage‑compute architecture suited for large‑scale deployments. [c10, c14, c15, c20, c22, c25]

Qdrant delivers the highest raw query throughput and memory efficiency in benchmarks, with ultra‑low latency (2‑4 ms) for 10 M vector collections, making it strong for latency‑critical RAG workloads. [c21, c23]
Weaviate provides hybrid search combining vector and keyword queries, built‑in RAG orchestration tools, and native LLM integrations, which can reduce custom development effort. [c11, c16, c24]
limitations: The Skeptic adversarially checked 5 of 18 web-sourced claims (cost control); the rest were not challenged.

Excluded c18 ('Weaviate is built in Go and offers a native GraphQL interface with integrated RAG capabili') because counter-evidence contradicted it: The evidence shows Weaviate's GraphQL API is deprecated and will be disabled, and clients query via gRPC, contradicting the claim of a native GraphQL interface. (source: https://docs.weaviate.io/weaviate/api/graphql)
Licensing for Weaviate is not confirmed; the claim only notes that GitHub could not auto‑detect it.
Performance data is limited to a single benchmark instance for Qdrant; comparable benchmarks for Milvus and Weaviate are not provided.
All claims are untested tier‑1 or tier‑3 sources, so factual accuracy cannot be independently verified.
assumptions: The "top 3" are interpreted as the three open-source projects mentioned in the claims.
Comparison criteria are limited to activity, licensing, community size, scalability features, performance benchmarks, and RAG‑related capabilities present in the claims.
next_steps: Verify the exact license of Weaviate by reviewing its LICENSE file.
Obtain comparable benchmark results for Milvus and Weaviate to assess performance relative to Qdrant.
Evaluate community support and ecosystem tooling (e.g., SDKs, integrations) for each database.

ledger.text: milvus-io/milvus has 46,513 GitHub stars and 4,318 forks.
milvus-io/milvus is released under the Apache-2.0 license.
milvus-io/milvus was last pushed to on 2026-10-28, has 1,495 open issues, and archived=False.
weaviate/weaviate has 16,925 GitHub stars and 1,430 forks.
weaviate/weaviate: GitHub could not auto-detect a standard license; check the repository's LICENSE file.
weaviate/weaviate was last pushed to on 2026-10-28, has 810 open issues, and archived=False.
qdrant/qdrant has 35,299 GitHub stars and 2,782 forks.
qdrant/qdrant is released under the Apache-2.0 license.
qdrant/qdrant was last pushed to on 2026-10-28, has 802 open issues, and archived=False.
Milvus is a high-performance open-source vector database that supports billions of vectors and offers features like metadata filtering, hybrid search, and multi-vector.
ledger.quote: Milvus is a high-performance open-source vector database that is mainly built for generative AI applications. It comes with RAG, image search, multimodal search, hybrid search, and allows scaling elastically to support tens of billions of vectors.
ledger.verdict_note: The counter-evidence discusses complexity, resource use, and cost for smaller workloads, but does not refute Milvus's ability to support billions of vectors or its features. (source: https://thecodersblog.com/milvus-an-open-source-vector-database-2026/)

ledger.text: Weaviate is an open-source AI database that provides hybrid search combining vector and BM25 keyword search and supports multi-vector storage.
ledger.quote: Weaviate is an open-source AI database for developers who love to build software applications. It helps to enhance semantic understanding and accuracy for better insights by using hybrid search with vector and BM25 keyword search.
ledger.verdict_note: No counter-evidence found at https://forum.weaviate.io/t/assistance-needed-to-improve-weaviates-vector-search-performance/3096 (searched: 'Weaviate limitations hybrid search performance issues'). This is a single-source check, not proof.

ledger.text: Weaviate can be deployed as a self‑hosted database or used as a managed service.
ledger.quote: It’s a self-hosted database and managed service.
ledger.verdict_note: The evidence only discusses UI availability, not whether self‑hosted deployment is possible, so it does not contradict the claim. (source: https://forum.weaviate.io/t/no-usable-ui-for-self-hosted-weaviate/20954)

ledger.text: Qdrant can be deployed both self‑hosted and as a managed service.
Milvus offers enterprise‑grade scalability handling billions of vectors.
ledger.quote: Milvus: Enterprise‑grade scalability, handles billions of vectors

ledger.text: Milvus supports multiple indexing algorithms (IVF_FLAT, IVF_SQ8, HNSW, ANNOY) allowing speed/accuracy trade‑offs.
ledger.quote: Milvus supports multiple indexing algorithms (IVF_FLAT, IVF_SQ8, HNSW, ANNOY), each with different speed/accuracy tradeoffs.

ledger.text: Weaviate provides hybrid search combining vector similarity with traditional keyword search and filtering.
ledger.quote: Weaviate stands out for its hybrid search capabilities, combining vector similarity with traditional keyword search and filtering.

ledger.text: Qdrant is written in Rust, delivering high performance especially for filtered searches.
ledger.quote: Qdrant is written in Rust, providing memory safety and performance advantages.

ledger.text: Weaviate is built in Go and offers a native GraphQL interface with integrated RAG capabilities.
ledger.quote: Weaviate is built on a simple premise: developers shouldn't need to be ML experts to build semantic applications. It's written in Go and designed as a vector search engine with a knowledge graph approach.
ledger.verdict_note: The evidence shows Weaviate's GraphQL API is deprecated and will be disabled, and clients query via gRPC, contradicting the claim of a native GraphQL interface. (source: https://docs.weaviate.io/weaviate/api/graphql)

ledger.text: Qdrant is written in Rust, focuses on high performance and memory-efficient HNSW implementation, and supports edge deployment.
ledger.quote: Qdrant is written in Rust and built for performance at scale. Its design philosophy is clear: do one thing (vector search) incredibly well, with minimal resource overhead and maximum throughput.

ledger.text: Milvus uses a decoupled storage and compute architecture, supports Kubernetes-native deployment, and is suited for billion‑scale vector search.
ledger.quote: Milvus is designed for enterprise scale. Its architecture separates storage and compute, enabling independent scaling of query nodes and index nodes—critical for billion-vector deployments.

ledger.text: In benchmark tests on a c6i.4xlarge instance, Qdrant achieved the highest raw query throughput and memory efficiency.
ledger.quote: Qdrant leads in raw performance and memory efficiency, especially with binary quantization.
ledger.verdict_note: No counter-evidence found at https://qdrant.tech/documentation/ops-optimization/optimize/ (searched: 'Qdrant benchmark raw query throughput c6i.4xlarge limitations'). This is a single-source check, not proof.

ledger.text: Milvus excels at horizontal scaling, making it suitable for large‑scale deployments.
Qdrant provides ultra-low latency of 2-4ms for 10M vector collections, making it suitable for latency-critical edge and serverless RAG workloads.
Weaviate offers built-in RAG orchestration tools and native integrations with LLMs such as GPT-5 and Claude 4, reducing the need for custom code.
ledger.quote: It integrates directly with popular embedding models and LLMs, offering built-in RAG orchestration tools.

ledger.text: Milvus 2.4 supports petabyte-scale distributed clusters and can handle 1B+ vector collections, targeting large‑scale enterprise RAG deployments.
Weaviate provides compliance certifications for regulated industries such as healthcare and finance.
ledger.quote: compliance certifications for healthcare and finance.

ledger.text: Milvus 2.4 includes GPU‑accelerated indexing that reduces query latency by about 40% for 10M vector collections.
